Description.English: Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, northerly winds will strengthen today, reaching force 6 with gusts, and temperature will begin to drop. On Wednesday and Thursday (25th and 26th Nov), the weather will be cool, with minimum temperature around 15 degrees Celsius. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take appropriate measures. Additionally, due to astronomical tides in the coming days, seawater inundation is expected within the Inner Harbor area on Wednesday(25th Nov) night. The public is advised to pay attention.( Update Time: 2026-11-24 07H00 )
